name: Ketchuk Bangor
original_name: ケチャック・バンゴー
source: One of the four members of the Imperial Council of Helman, he's in charge of the five armies of the Nation and is the direct superior of each army's general.
translation: One of the four members of the Imperial Council of Helman, he's in charge of the five armies of the Nation and is the direct superior of each army's general.
